name: Enoch
bio:
Enoch is the son of Jared and father of Methuselah, one of only a few figures in Scripture who never experienced death but was taken directly by God. Scripture twice emphasizes that "Enoch walked with God," recording with brief but profound weight: "Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him" (Genesis 5:21-24).

Enoch walked with God for three hundred years — not merely a summary statement, but the Old Testament's defining picture of intimate walking with God. The New Testament book of Hebrews notes that by faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death, because he had this testimony, that he pleased God — proof that without faith it is impossible to please Him (Hebrews 11:5). Though his recorded life is remarkably brief, Enoch is Scripture's earliest witness that walking with God can overcome even death.
